tasks.short: Discuss individual children's needs and progress with professionals

steps.what: Meet with other professionals to discuss individual students' needs, progress and possible support

tasks.design: Keep the professional discussion human, using existing observation notes in {DOCS} where authorised. Do not assume that generating meeting notes shortens the discussion needed to understand a child.
tasks.previous_blocker: The professionals must reconcile different observations and understand uncertainty.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing authorised records support discussion without a new tool.
tasks.still_hard: Agreeing support when progress varies across settings or evidence is incomplete.
tasks.human_edge: Explain classroom context and hear another professional's interpretation.
tasks.altitude: Meeting time, support responsibilities and decision rights stay unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify responsibility for a proposed classroom support action
reach.learn: Professional roles and limits on information sharing

evidence.claim: Discussion of individual support needs involves contextual professional judgement and agreement; this design retains it.

assumptions: Boundary is this teacher's discussion contribution, not other professionals' attendance, formal assessment or subsequent support delivery.

Existing observations are produced by the teacher during ordinary teaching outside this meeting boundary; their capture remains unchanged and earns no saving. Discussion itself produces the proposed actions with all teacher time retained.
No automatic child profile, diagnosis, structured needs flag or recording is introduced. Native authorised document access is sufficient.
Zero incremental upkeep because there is no new automation, record format or data feed.
research_questions: Which uncertainties require a live exchange rather than another summary document?

already_counted.description: Discuss evidence, needs and possible support with professionals

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and net zero. Retain all professional discussion; no invented minutes-writing or scheduling baseline is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select, inventory, order, store and issue classroom supplies

steps.what: Select classroom equipment, materials and supplies suitable for planned activities
Inventory equipment, materials and supplies by checking usable quantities and condition
Prepare and confirm classroom equipment and supply orders
Store equipment and supplies safely and issue classroom materials for use

tasks.design: Use saved catalogue lines in {PROCUREMENT} to prepare requisitions from the teacher's checked shortage list. Keep material selection, physical inventory, storage and issue with the teacher; the confirmed request follows existing purchasing authority.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated item and pack details are re-entered even when classroom stock still needs a physical check.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved requisitions can reuse catalogue fields without inferring stock levels.
tasks.still_hard: Suitability for young children, damaged stock and changing classroom demand.
tasks.human_edge: Choose safe, useful materials and notice items that are no longer fit for use.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated order entry; material choice and physical handling retain their time.

reach.learn: Catalogue units and age-appropriate material requirements

evidence.claim: Saved requisition lines can reuse catalogue details while a teacher checks shortages and confirms quantities.

assumptions: Boundary covers teacher selection, inventory, requisition and handling. Purchasing approval, supplier fulfilment and finance payment are outside and unchanged.
Teacher produces item id, usable quantity, condition and shortage quantity during s2 with all 25 hours retained. No par level, stock sensor or structured shortage arrives for free.

Supplier maintains catalogue code, pack unit and price; teacher checks current details and enters requested quantities in s3's retained 10 hours. Changed items use manual entry and coordinator review.
Received supplies are produced by the existing supplier delivery outside this boundary; no saving is claimed in fulfilment or receipt transport.
Test native saved requisitions before code. s3 confirmation binds the finished request, not authority to bypass purchasing approval. Physical storage and issue retain all 30 hours.
research_questions: How much requisition time is duplicate catalogue entry versus checking suitable quantities and materials?

already_counted.description: Choose materials, count stock, confirm requisitions and handle supplies

incremental.description: Check saved catalogue lines for changed packs or discontinued items

approvals.approved_version: Final requisition with item codes, quantities, pack units, total and destination; edits void confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=25+25+10+30=90; gross 10 less upkeep 1 gives net 9. E1 scenario halves requisition effort on repeated catalogue items only; unusual materials or existing saved requests may leave no gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan assignments, supervise and evaluate assistants and volunteers

steps.what: Plan assignments for teacher assistants and volunteers based on activities and experience
Supervise assistants and volunteers during classroom work and provide immediate guidance
Evaluate assistant and volunteer performance and discuss constructive feedback

tasks.design: Keep assignment judgement, classroom supervision and feedback human, with existing assignment notes in {DOCS}. No worker scoring, automated allocation or additional monitoring record is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safe assignments depend on experience, trust and the day's classroom needs.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing notes already support the human process; no additional technology is needed.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing when an assistant needs intervention and giving fair feedback.
tasks.human_edge: Coach sensitively while protecting children's care and learning.
tasks.altitude: Supervisory time and responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.task: Agree a development goal for an assistant

evidence.claim: Classroom supervision and fair evaluation rely on contextual observation and conversation rather than a deterministic worker score.

assumptions: Boundary includes only the teacher's planning, supervision and evaluation; assistants' and volunteers' own delivery time remains outside.
Teacher obtains availability and experience directly in s1, retains all observation in s2 and gives feedback in s3. No structured performance or availability input feeds a machine action.
Native document use stays unchanged and earns no saving. Zero incremental upkeep because no new allocation, recording or evaluation system is added.
research_questions: Which assignment changes depend on direct knowledge of the assistant and the children?

already_counted.description: Plan assignments, supervise classroom work and discuss evaluation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and net zero. Retain all assignment judgement, live supervision and feedback; no unobserved roster administration is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Administer developmental tests and interpret children's needs

steps.what: Prepare the appropriate developmental test, materials and individual administration conditions
Administer tests to children and observe responses under the test instructions
Interpret test responses to inform developmental levels, needs and potential within professional limits

tasks.design: Retain test preparation, administration and qualified interpretation with the teacher under approved instructions in {DOCS}. Do not introduce automated developmental classification or infer a child's potential from a machine score.
tasks.previous_blocker: Developmental test validity depends on the instrument, administration conditions and the child's context.
tasks.enabler_now: No new technology or test instrument is assumed in this design.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing a test response from a broader conclusion about development or support needs.
tasks.human_edge: Support the child and interpret cautiously within training and test limitations.
tasks.altitude: Assessment time and professional limits stay unchanged; no diagnostic authority is gained.

reach.task: Decide what further professional assessment question to raise
reach.learn: Test limitations and appropriate referral routes

evidence.claim: Valid developmental testing requires suitable instruments, administration and cautious interpretation; this design does not automate classification.

assumptions: Boundary covers only tests the teacher is trained and authorised to administer, not clinical diagnosis, admission decisions or specialist testing. Interpretation is a qualified input to existing support processes.
Teacher produces recorded responses and administration observations in s2 with all 55 hours retained. No structured developmental label, automated score or free response capture feeds a machine step.
Existing approved instructions are supplied by the test publisher outside this task; access and instrument permissions remain unchanged. No new test or software is introduced.
Check the approved instrument's native facilities before considering a future build. Zero incremental upkeep because this design changes neither test content nor processing.
unknowns: Limits on interpretation and onward sharing
research_questions: Which conclusions are supported by the instrument and which require specialist assessment?

already_counted.description: Prepare and administer tests and interpret within professional limits

incremental.description: No added automation or instrument upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and net zero. Retain preparation, child interaction, response capture and interpretation; no saving from substituting an unvalidated assessment method is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The teacher can reduce repeated supply ordering while keeping child-progress discussion, supervision and developmental assessment intact.
reach: Coordinate suitable classroom supplies with purchasing
Clarify support-action ownership with the support coordinator
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who spends less effort repeating catalogue details and retains full attention for children and the adults supporting them.
